result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, with clear hierarchy, consistent card layouts, and no major rendering failures. The main visual defect is a system gesture bar overlapping the bottom navigation icons. A minor contrast concern appears in the grey secondary text. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card were excluded as intentional scroll affordances.

issues.description: The black home-indicator/gesture bar at the bottom of the screen overlaps the bottom navigation, partially covering the search icon and crowding the bookmark icon.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding so the navigation icons sit above the system gesture area, and keep the nav bar's icons fully visible and unobstructed.

issues.description: Secondary grey text (delivery fees, delivery times, the review count '(500+)', and the 'Ramen' category label) appears light against the white background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet at least WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text).
